prompt:
Extract the event details into JSON.
Rules:
- `event_title`: exact title as written in the source text.
- `start_date`: convert the event date to ISO format `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `ticket_price_usd`: numeric value only, with no currency symbol.
- `audience_rating`: must be one of `general`, `teen`, or `adult`.
- `has_live_music`: boolean only (`true` or `false`).
- `sponsor_name`: exact sponsor name only if it is explicitly mentioned; otherwise return null.
- Do not invent missing values.
- Return only valid JSON matching the schema.

training_data.source_text: The Midnight Market opens at Union Yard on October 3, 2026. Admission is $12. The notice says it is suitable for all ages. No live music is scheduled. The event is supported by Ember Bank.

The After Dark Film Expo will be held on November 21, 2026, at the Old Foundry Hall. Tickets are priced at $25. Due to mature screening themes, the listing marks the event for adults only. A live synth set follows the final screening. No sponsor is named in the announcement.
